description: ACTGOV Smart Parking Transmitter Assets is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). This point dataset shows the locations of Smart Parking Transmitters in the Australian Capital Territory. These assets are either owned or managed by City Services, City and Environment Directorate (CED). Assets managed and / or owned privately, by other ACT Government Directorates or by the Federal Government may not be included. Coverage: ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Its tags are asset, ced, community-facilities-and-assets, electrical-and-mechanical, ict-hardware. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
